findings.detail: Identifier maturity parsing corrupts or mis-associates dates; the filing maturity cells support the structured dates for the flagged positions.

rationale: This is a Class 2 within-row conflict. Targeted raw-source checks show filing maturities of 01/17/31 for Granicus, 12/17/32 for the current Sapiens row, 07/06/27 for Southeast Mechanical, 02/24/31 for Project Accelerate, and 10/30/26 for Acquia, matching the structured/XBRL side rather than the identifier-side values. Splash has multiple instruments, and the cited 03/17/31 source row grounds the structured date for the flagged same-issuer position. The identifier-side values therefore reflect extraction/parsing and row-association defects, not bad filing anchors.
